title: The oscillator boundary and infinite process are charged
statement: Vacuum input, number-preserving quadratic auxiliaryH, passive linear damping and bounded system drive yield E[(N)_k]<=(||Q||||c||t)^(2k), hence Poisson-type tail withlambda=(aT)²,a=||Q||||c||. Total occupation cutoffK omits onlyHamiltonianK-to-K+1 edge, preserves hopping and lowering jumps, gives full-channel error<=min(2,2aT sqrt(K+1)sqrt(lambda^K/K!)). Uniform finite-cutoff comparison defines normalCPTP vacuum process via Cauchy limit, not uniqueness of arbitrary formal unbounded GKSL extension. BinaryM ceil(log2(K+1)) bath qubits plus reversible total-number arithmetic, no enumerated binomial Fock table. K, hopping/drive/loss implementation, coefficient and evolution errors remain paid; theorem new source-derived/unreviewed.
